suppress.notes: CVE-2026-84218 affects the JSR-160 proxy in Jolokia 1.x. Jolokia's upstream issue confirms the affected range includes all 1.x versions from 1.5.0 onward and fixes it in 2.6.2 by requiring explicit proxy target allowlisting. The fix is a major-version upgrade with a behavior/configuration change, so it is deferred to the dependency-modernization effort. This suppression is a temporary exception, not remediation. Follow-up: https://github.com/jolokia/jolokia/issues/1049
